Thanks for the report and the demo repo. Note: I couldn't search existing issues or the repo in this session, so I haven't confirmed whether this is a duplicate or what the provider code does.

Two things that may explain what you see:

1. Playwright only supports Chrome extensions in a persistent context (`launchPersistentContext`). Extensions are generally not loaded with a plain `browser.launch()` plus `--load-extension` args. Check whether the Playwright provider options in the docs (`guide/browser/playwright`) offer a persistent-context option, and whether it works with your setup. Extensions usually also need headed mode or the new headless mode.
2. Vitest runs tests in an iframe. Content scripts only inject into frames if the manifest sets `all_frames: true`, and the `matches` pattern has to cover the Vitest dev server URL (for example `http://localhost:63315/*`).

If both are set and it still fails, please add the exact manifest `content_scripts` block and confirm whether the extension appears in `chrome://extensions` during the run. Treating this as a feature request for now. I can't promise any change.
